page.layout: One framed text block with a running head above it; below the heading an ornament (woodcut) fills the frame; a foot line with a number at left and a place name at right.
page.notes: The page carries a decorative woodcut ornament (a diamond-shaped arabesque with a small rosette at its centre) below the heading; it is not text. Faint show-through text from the reverse side (headings such as "De Scripturarum insufficientia", "De Authoritate Scripturæ", "De Transubstantione") is ignored. The foot line reads "XXII." at left and "ROMA" at right; "ROMA" is treated as a catchword-like foot element, which may be a printer's place line.
